text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You were invited to observe the training 
of Bitter Glace, trained by Trainer 
Kashimoto, along with Byerley Turk.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For Bitter Glace, who desired intense 
training, Byerley Turk, skilled at raising 
strong Umamusume, was the perfect support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satisfied with her training, Bitter Glace 
talks about her dream of using her 
physical strength to put up a fiery fight 
against any opponent, no matter how 
superior they are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if answering those feelings, Trainer 
Kashimoto set the grand stage of the 
Classic races as their next objective.
